name: PALB2cc homodimer
notes: Current LogicGate scaffold; classical antiparallel LZ; heterodimer with BRCA1cc also solved; Kd ~6 µM for BRCA1cc

name: apCC-Di homodimer
notes: Woolfson lab; hyperthermostable de novo antiparallel dimer; extensively characterised in solution and crystal

name: apCC-Di-AB heterodimer
notes: Woolfson/Hoecker; de novo AP heterodimer designed for intracellular delivery; orthogonal to parallel CCs;1

name: apCC-Di-AB_var heterodimer
notes: Variant of 7Q1T with altered surface residues; tests specificity tuning

name: apCC-Tet homotetramer
notes: Woolfson; de novo antiparallel 4-helix bundle; used as scaffold for phosphoswitch designs; PDB entry for switch series

name: apCC-Tet* homotetramer (4hr)
notes: Naudin/Woolfson 2022; shorter 4-heptad version for compact switch scaffolds

name: apCC-Tet*-A2B2 heterotetramer (3hr)
notes: 3-heptad heterotetramer; useful for shorter linker geometry tests

name: JIP3-LZII antiparallel dimer
notes: JIP3 leucine zipper II; natural AP switch — parallel (JIP4) vs antiparallel (JIP3) depending on N-term truncation; buries Asn as specificity determinant

name: GCN4-pLI antiparallel tetramer
notes: Single g-position mutation converts parallel GCN4-pLI tetramer to AP; illustrates orientation bistability; good negative-design control

name: GCN4-N16A antiparallel trimer
priority_tier: N16A GCN4 mutant; accidental AP trimer; illustrates buried-Asn as orientation switch; negative design reference

name: GCN4 3-3-1 antiparallel tetramer
notes: g-position hydrophobic substitution drives AP tetramer; knobs-into-knobs packing at g; useful for understanding AP packing rules

name: ACC-Hex antiparallel hexamer
priority_tier: Phe-Ile zipper AP hexamer; high thermostability; too large for compact switch but useful as stability reference

name: COMP AP dimer
notes: Cartilage oligomeric matrix protein coiled-coil; AP dimer within pentameric context; well-studied natural AP dimer
